headline: Apple races to make Siri more agentic with third-party app control
summary: Future Siri versions will gain fine-grained control over first-party apps and integrate with third-party services, aiming to compete with advanced AI agents.
details: Apple is reportedly accelerating its Siri roadmap to develop a more powerful AI agent capable of competing with rivals like OpenAI's Dots and Meta's Muse. The push comes amid pressure to keep pace with the rapidly evolving AI landscape.
Initial improvements expected with iOS 17.3 will grant Siri enhanced control over Apple's own applications, enabling actions such as image manipulation in Photos and tab management in Safari.

A more significant upgrade, slated for a Spring release, will introduce third-party app integration. This will allow Siri to perform tasks like ordering food via Grubhub or making restaurant reservations through OpenTable.

The ultimate goal is to make Siri more 'agentic,' meaning it can track goals, determine next steps, and pursue objectives autonomously without constant user input, similar to current advanced AI assistants.
